title: ReceiptResponse
description: Answer to a ReceiptRequest, notified by the station to the app on BLE characteristic FFF6, inside the channel (profiles/offline/ble-transport.md §8): the session's signed receipt, or a refusal in the one BLE error shape (07-errors.md §2.3).

receipt.description: The session's receipt, exactly as the station signed it - the object the app stores and uploads (spec/profiles/offline/app-contract.md §4). Present when result is Accepted.

errorCode.description: 3006 SESSION_NOT_FOUND when the station serves no receipt for the requested session (07-errors.md §4.3). Present when result is Rejected.

errorText.description: The registry name of errorCode, in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Present when result is Rejected.

details.description: Per-occurrence context of the refusal (07-errors.md §2.3). MAY be present when result is Rejected.
